title: Local Gemma node runtime component
task: Define a local Gemma runtime node that keeps raw evidence local while exposing reviewed knowledge-object outputs, audit traces, and model route metadata.

title: Kubernetes vLLM inference service component
task: Define a Kubernetes-hosted vLLM inference service component with GPU scheduling, model swap metadata, autoscaling hints, and cost telemetry hooks.

title: Ollama local adapter component
task: Define an Ollama-compatible local model adapter with deterministic health checks, model inventory capture, and privacy-local execution metadata.

title: llama.cpp edge runtime component
task: Define a llama.cpp edge runtime component with quantization metadata, CPU/GPU fallback, token throughput checks, and offline deployment notes.

title: LoRA fine-tuning job component
task: Define a LoRA fine-tuning job component with dataset license checks, privacy review, training config capture, evaluation gates, and model card output.

title: QLoRA cost-aware fine-tuning job component
task: Define a QLoRA training component for cheap supervised adaptation with quantization config, GPU memory budget, eval rows, and rollback metadata.

title: Distillation benchmark builder component
task: Define a benchmark builder for distilling repeated pipeline behavior into eval rows and candidate small-model training data without exposing raw user context.

title: Federated reviewed-object publisher component
task: Define a publisher that shares only reviewed, redacted, attribution-bounded learning objects across local deployments while keeping raw files local.

title: Federated reviewed-object receiver component
task: Define a receiver that verifies signed knowledge objects from other deployments, routes them through trust scoring, and stages them for RAG/index updates.

title: Model card cost profiler component
task: Define a profiler that records model cost, throughput, context window, modality support, and deployment constraints as searchable model-route metadata.

title: Training data sensitive-content gate component
task: Define a pre-training gate that screens candidate training rows for PII, secrets, raw case narratives, license conflicts, and high-risk content requiring human approval.

title: Kubernetes batch training runtime component
task: Define a Kubernetes batch training runtime with job manifests, object storage mounts, secret boundaries, GPU scheduling, and resumable checkpoint handling.
